Kolkata Knight Riders produced a clinical all-round performance to defeat Sunrisers Hyderabad by seven wickets in IPL 2026. SRH got off to a flying start, reaching 105/1 inside nine overs with Travis Head smashing 61 off 28, but Varun Chakaravarthy’s breakthrough triggered a dramatic collapse as the hosts were bundled out for 165 in 19 overs. Sunil Narine also shone, reaching the milestone of 200 IPL wickets while combining with Varun for key middle-over strikes. In reply, Finn Allen’s quick 29 set the tone before Ajinkya Rahane and Angkrish Raghuvanshi stitched a match-defining partnership, with Raghuvanshi top-scoring with 59.
